title: Spec 014 Durable Tenant Authority Row Cardinality

phases.objective: Prove durable Tenant authority identity cardinality before reading one SQL row and fail closed for ambiguous results.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical durable Tenant authority store loadCurrent SQL read path
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Empty results return null, multiple results fail with STORAGE_DURABLE_AUTHORITY_ROW_AMBIGUOUS, and exactly one proven result is destructured without arbitrary first-candidate selection.
steps: Normalize the database response into a bounded row collection.

Return null only when the bounded collection is empty.
Destructure the sole remaining row and parse it through the canonical record validator.
Run the existing durable authority functional suite and the focused cardinality regression.
